name: phyxel-gamedev
description: Game-development workflow for the Phyxel voxel engine. Bundles skills for the guided production loop (milestone tracker → shippable), the build/launch/iterate loop, world building, characters, assets, gameplay mechanics, and packaging. Pairs with the per-project `phyxel` MCP server (see docs/GameDevWorkflow.md and docs/game-production/README.md). Install once per machine; activate per project with `phyxel link` / `phyxel new`.
